article_notes: 108 PCR-confirmed Babesia-infected dogs (species not reported; B. gibsoni and B. canis named as the Indian species) from Madras Veterinary College Teaching Hospital and Blue Cross of India, sampled on the first day of presentation (treatment timing not stated). Severity is anaemia only (anaemic vs non-anaemic, criteria not given). All numeric results are in figures (Fig. 1-4) that are not in the text; only P values, the ROC cut-off, AUC, sensitivity and specificity are printed. Haemoglobin, PCV and erythrocytes define the anaemia groups and their group comparison is not extracted. The serum iron-LHD regression is marker vs marker, not severity. No healthy controls.

severity_definitions.label: anaemic vs non-anaemic dogs with babesiosis
severity_definitions.definition: PCR-confirmed Babesia-infected dogs grouped as anaemic or non-anaemic on haemoglobin, PCV and erythrocyte count (cut-offs not stated), sampled on the first day of presentation.
severity_definitions.quote: the affected animals were grouped into anaemic (n = 58, Male - 25, Female – 33) and non-anaemic group (n = 50, Male - 22, Female – 28)

severity_definitions.label: degree of anaemia (haemoglobin, PCV, erythrocyte count as continuous measures)
severity_definitions.definition: Continuous haemoglobin, PCV and erythrocyte count across all 108 infected dogs, used as measures of anaemia severity in Pearson correlations with LHD.
severity_definitions.quote: Pearson correlation between LHD and other standard anaemic parameters revealed the significant (P<0.01) negative relationship of LHD to haemoglobin, packed cell volume, erythrocytes, MCHC and serum iron (Fig. 2).

associations.statistic: unpaired Student's t-test; group values only in Fig. 1
associations.quote: Serum iron was significantly reduced and LHD, TIBC and UIBC were significantly (P<0.001) elevated in the infected dogs with anaemia (Fig. 1).
associations.note: LHD% is calculated from MCHC by a sigmoid formula; MCHC itself is part of the red cell indices. Per-group values only in Fig. 1.

associations.statistic: ROC for anaemic vs non-anaemic: AUC 0.935, Youden's index 0.804, cut-off >1.83%
associations.quote: Receiver operating characteristics (ROC) curve analysis identified the anaemic diagnostic cut-off value as >1.83% at the confidence interval of 84.3 and 98.2% (P<0.001) with 100.00% specificity and 80.43% sensitivity. Area under curve (AUC) of LHD was about 0.935
associations.note: The article prints 'confidence interval of 84.3 and 98.2%' attached to the cut-off; unclear whether this is the CI of sensitivity or of the AUC, so it is not entered as effect_ci. The abstract calls the target 'functional iron deficient anaemia'; the results call it the anaemic group.

associations.note: Negative correlation with haemoglobin means higher LHD goes with more severe anaemia, so direction is positive_association with severity. n_total assumed to be all 108 dogs. Coefficient only in Fig. 2.
